properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 29 live HTTPS client sessions in the shipped tool surface: global fetch()/axios calls to RPC providers (Helius mainnet RPC with API key in the URL at send_tx.ts:70), DEX APIs (Jupiter, Mayan, Manifest, Drift, Lulo, Voltr, Solayer), weather API, etc. Node.js default TLS config — TLS 1.3 with X25519 classical key exchange, no post-quantum group offered; harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure on all provider/API traffic. Fixable here: swap to a runtime/lib offering hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Keccak/SHA-3 (keccak@3.x, keccak256@1.0.6, @ethersproject/keccak256@5.7/5.8) resolved across wormhole-nextjs-agent, para-plugin-example, phantom-agent-starter, orbofi-personality-engine, discord-bot-starter and the root pnpm workspace. Keccak-256 is the EVM/Sei/wormhole message digest — heavily used for address derivation and tx hashing in this Solana+multichain agent kit. SHA-3/Keccak is quantum-resistant against Grover beyond 256-bit capacity; fine to keep.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: PBKDF2 arrives via pbkdf2@3.x, @ethersproject/pbkdf2@5.7/5.8 and @types/pbkdf2 resolved in wormhole-nextjs-agent, phantom-agent-starter, orbofi-personality-engine and the root pnpm workspace. PBKDF2 is the password KDF used by the ethers/BIP39 mnemonic paths (browserify pbkdf2, 2048-iteration legacy variant in ethers v5) and by WASM-crypto stacks. Quantum-vulnerable only via its HMAC-SHA underlayer; keep iterations per OWASP.
